peak_previous_day.reason: The retained compact artifact stores the peak snapshot but not the preceding daily row or position history.

peak_day.reason: Assets, cash, position value, and the maximum-drawdown peak are retained; position stops and ATR history are not.

first_warning_previous_day.reason: The retained compact artifact stores the first warning snapshot but not its preceding daily row or position history.

first_warning_day.reason: The warning snapshot and maximum-drawdown peak assets are retained; position stops and ATR history are not.

peak_exposure_at_least_0_94.interpretation: Gross exposure alone cannot distinguish failures from healthy high-return paths.

peak_symbol_count_at_most_2_and_exposure.interpretation: Concentration adds useful separation but cannot cover the whole failure cohort by itself.

historical_trough_loss_avoidance_lower_b.definition: For each failure, max(0, 0.82 * peak_assets - trough_assets). This is an accounting lower bound, not a claim that a causal strategy can capture it exactly.

read_only_mechanism_analysis.conclusion: A static gross cap is rejected by the controls. A single causal rule remains testable only if it uses stop/ATR loss, treats same-group books as correlated, and tightens monotonically with lifetime-peak cushion. The missing prior-day stop/ATR history prevents an ex-ante proof from the compact artifact, so feasibility must be decided by the preregistered ladder rather than parameter search.

runtime_call_path: Each sleeve generates close-known signals and updates effective position stops.
The route controller may add migration orders after the sleeve close decisions.
The merged-account risk manager updates the lifetime peak without resetting it on cycle rearm.
C4 evaluates all held books and pending buys after the close, before any next-session open execution.
C4 emits immutable next-open risk sells and clips or removes pending buys; existing ADV, fees, slippage, limits, sell priority, and T+1 handling remain authoritative.

formula.group_adverse_loss: sum(book_adverse_loss for books in the same risk group)
notes: Same-group books receive no diversification credit; one-symbol and one-group portfolios remain fully constrained.
The 50% residual-group charge is a transparent stress credit, not covariance estimation.
Existing positions use the close and effective stop/ATR known at that close; proposed orders use their signal-date stop/ATR.
A proposed order with missing or non-finite stop/ATR evidence is rejected. An existing book with missing evidence is charged its full marked value.
Risk sells use the existing next-executable-open queue; no intraday fill or daily-OHLC interpolation is introduced.

state_machine.normal_to_constrained: Enter when projected_adverse_loss exceeds available_budget or the existing account warning becomes active.
constrained_actions: Cancel ordinary pending buys, adds, and route-migration buys while the existing account warning is active.
Queue one proportional risk reduction when projected loss exceeds budget and cushion or causal stop/ATR risk has worsened; price appreciation alone is not a reduction trigger.
Do not duplicate an equal or stronger pending risk sell while ADV capacity is completing the prior reduction.
state_machine.constrained_to_recovering: After at least five trading days, require three consecutive closes with no account warning, projected-loss ratio <= 0.8, and drawdown recovered by at least 0.02 from the constrained-state maximum.
state_machine.recovering_reentry: Authorize at most the adverse-loss capacity left by available_budget. Capacity increases monotonically with lifetime-peak cushion; it never jumps to ordinary full risk merely because a cycle lock rearmed.
state_machine.recovering_to_normal: Require three consecutive closes with no warning, projected-loss ratio <= 0.8, and lifetime drawdown <= 0.05.
invariants: lifetime_peak_assets is monotone and is never reset by route, sleeve, cycle lock, or rearm
warning state cannot increase projected adverse loss
no negative cash or short position is introduced
all symbols, dates, scenarios, and seeds use the same rule

configuration_selection_rule: Evaluate both preregistered configurations together at L1. Discard any configuration that misses a hard gate. If both pass, retain balanced. If only one passes, retain that one. If neither passes, stop before L2. No intermediate value may be introduced.

synthetic_contracts: lifetime peak survives cycle rearm and route changes
winner appreciation alone never queues a trim
worsening stop/ATR risk queues a next-open reduction
underwater re-entry grows monotonically with cushion
no negative cash, shorts, duplicate orders/fills, same-day sale of a new buy, or future data

validation_ladder.L2: Run the exact retained 281 failure/boundary/control cohort once.
validation_ladder.L3: Run affected fixed families and preregistered deterministic random shards only after L2 passes.
validation_ladder.L4: Run the exact canonical 983 once for the stable final candidate only after L3 passes.
